active_contrast.interpretation: temporal_regularisation contrast at a matched analysis frequency; not proof of entrainment mechanism

preprocessing.reference: common average across frozen-QC good scalp channels
preprocessing.narrowband_phase_filter: target frequency plus or minus 1 Hz on the full 7-second epoch, followed by trimming to the frozen analysis window

primary_neural_estimand.uncertainty: two-sided 95% t interval with participant bootstrap sensitivity
primary_neural_estimand.equivalence_rule: two one-sided tests using the 90% confidence interval within plus or minus 0.3 dz; operational measurement bound, not a clinical MCID
primary_neural_estimand.null_interpretation: non-significant and non-equivalent is inconclusive, not evidence of absence

key_secondary_neural_estimands.purpose: non-phase-locked spectral control; interpreted jointly with evoked local SNR

multiplicity.key_secondary_family: Holm correction across evoked, total and induced local-SNR contrasts
multiplicity.behaviour_and_coupling: separate labeled family with Holm correction within family
multiplicity.exploratory_prediction: reported as estimation only, not used to rescue primary inference

internal_consistency.summary: Spearman correlation and Spearman-Brown corrected coefficient with bootstrap 95% interval

condition_contrasts: median correct RT ms: f_theta_plus minus non_rhythmic
inverse efficiency ms: f_theta_plus minus non_rhythmic
behavioural_estimands.primary_coupling: within-subject-condition association of leave-one-trial-out phase-alignment score with correctness and correct-trial RT
models: binomial GEE for correctness clustered by subject with condition interaction
Gaussian GEE for log correct RT clustered by subject with condition interaction
behavioural_estimands.centering: neural trial score centered within subject and condition
behavioural_estimands.behaviour_denominator: all event-valid trials in the two active-contrast conditions, independent of EEG artifact rejection
behavioural_estimands.coupling_population: event-valid trials that also pass the frozen EEG epoch artifact rules

prediction.outcome: participant theta-plus minus non-rhythmic inverse-efficiency contrast
prediction.validation: nested leave-one-subject-out cross-validation with inner tuning
prediction.minimum_claim: no individual-benefit claim without improvement over both comparators and uncertainty excluding no improvement

sensitivity_analyses: Wilcoxon signed-rank sensitivity for paired condition contrasts
repeat primary contrast using at least four good frontocentral ROI channels
report congruent and incongruent behavioural strata without changing the neural primary estimand
prohibited_adaptations: change ROI or analysis window based on confirmatory effect size
change technical inclusion thresholds after outcome inspection
include five development participants in primary estimates
replace non-rhythmic active control after viewing results
select a neural metric because it is significant
describe internal consistency as test-retest reliability
claim cognitive mediation or treatment efficacy from association
